name: Urakawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Urakawa town emblem in white: a ring of concentric broken arcs like a cogwheel around a central disc.
history: Municipal flag of Urakawa, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 26 July 1967.

features.role: Urakawa town emblem — a ring of concentric broken arcs like a cogwheel around a central disc
